name: unsafe fn from_raw (raw : * mut T) -> Self
rule: After Box::<T>::from_raw(raw), the resulting Box owns the allocation; raw must not be used to create another owning Box while that ownership remains in effect, as this can cause a double-free.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::boxed::Box < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (raw : * mut T) -> Self }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it requires tracking future owning-Box creation over an ownership interval, while the available observations describe only the current state.
